lead.headline: Sadiq's last practice is today; the flex is still a point off
lead.deck: Your only tight end has been limited twice with his back. Andrews is free if he sits. Downs still belongs in the flex. Across the matchup, Team 13 are losing DeVonta Smith.
lead.body: Kenyon Sadiq, the only tight end on this roster, was limited Wednesday and Thursday with a back injury he picked up on a diving touchdown catch, and this afternoon's practice is his last before a designation. No bench player can cover the slot, so the plan stays on the wire: if he is ruled out today or inactive at 09:30 Sunday, add Mark Andrews, a free agent who practised fully both days, and drop Carnell Tate. The other item is undone for a third edition running. The flex has Bhayshul Tuten in it; ESPN prefers Josh Downs by a point, a coin flip, and coin flips go to the projection. Downs locks at 07:30 Sunday in London. On the bench, Jaylen Wright's full practice Thursday, not the limited one yesterday's edition reported, makes Ollie Gordon half of a split, and Kellen Moore has said the same of Alvin Kamara and Kendre Miller. The better news is across the matchup: Team 13's DeVonta Smith is not expected to play and Rachaad White has missed two practices, which is why ESPN now has you at 64%.
